remarks: Townhouse at Terra Nova, a premier gated condominium community with pool in Westport. Enjoy spacious luxury and outdoor serenity without the upkeep and responsibility of a house. This townhouse is a back unit, private with wooded views and located right across from the pool. . 3 stories, all finished, hardwood floors on 1st floor w/gas fireplace. Great flow for entertaining with formal dining room, large eat-in kitchen with granite counters, walk in pantry, open to great room w/fireplace and sliders to deck. The powder rm and mud room with access to the 2 car garage completes this level. Upstairs is a gracious primary suite 2 walk-in closets and 2 additional bedrooms, hall bath and laundry.room with sink. Great walk-out lower level with gas fireplace providing versatile space for media room, exercise room, office space or anything else. Two car garage with epoxy floor, shelving system, and electric car charger. Neutral colors - light and bright! Move right in and enjoy easy living at Terra Nova! Very convenient location to shopping and for commuters. ...
